title: Units satisfying the Euler–Jacobi relation
statement: For a natural number $N$ with $N\ne 0$, consider the units modulo $N$. The defined subgroup consists of those units $u$ for which the Jacobi symbol modulo $N$ of the residue represented by $u$ equals $u^{(N-1)/2}$ in the residue ring modulo $N$.
